description: The three saved Find a Tender records each contain one historical release, so they cannot establish a current amendment or support a bidder-facing brief on their own. The existing trial can still test whether an official process history supplies a comparable revision and confirms that submissions are open. Independently, the SQLite release can be identified before its November 22 cutoff. Five unclassified feedback sources leave demand inconclusive. Treasury shows no verified available funds or revenue.
